description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper class and related factory functions for GStreamer utility operations within the Rialto server namespace. It includes functions for creating wrapper instances and performing audio track codec channel switching, with external dependencies on GStreamer and logging utilities.

classes.description: Factory interface for creating RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instances.

classes.description: Concrete factory class implementing the creation of RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper objects.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class providing GStreamer utility functions, including performing audio track codec channel switching.

methods.description: Static method returning a singleton instance of the factory.

methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instance.

methods.description: Performs a switch of the audio track codec channel, with parameters for playback group, sample attributes, audio attributes, and various control flags.
